title: Delete and Earn

examples.explanation: Choose 4 to earn 4 and delete 3. Then choose 2 to earn 2 more, for a total of 6.
Choose all three occurrences of 3, earning 9. Choosing the first 3 removes every 2 and 4.

inputFormat: Implement deleteAndEarn(nums), where nums contains positive integers. Choosing one occurrence of x earns x points and deletes all remaining values x - 1 and x + 1.
outputFormat: The maximum total points obtainable by repeatedly choosing remaining elements. Other occurrences of x remain available after choosing x.
